mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential housing starts (HOUST) signals robust consumer demand and construction activity, which correlates with rising corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.0% and remains above this level for two consecutive months, it indicates a tightening monetary cycle that reduces liquidity and equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a strengthening labor market and robust manufacturing activity, which together signal positive economic momentum and drive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of UNRATE decline and INDPRO increase fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of manufacturing expansion (INDPRO > 115), industrial output growth correlates with increased corporate capital expenditure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 115.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) consistently signals improving labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE declines.

mechanism_narrative: When residential housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1700 thousand units for two consecutive months, it indicates a weakening in the housing market and consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 1700 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 190 and a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2.5% signals an inflationary environment with accommodative monetary policy, which together drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of CPIAUCSL > 190 and FEDFUNDS < 2.5% fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 190) and low monetary policy rates (FEDFUNDS < 2.5%), the market anticipates central bank intervention to curb inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 190 and FEDFUNDS < 2.5%.
